body: Founder: 'do the first phase of the gband work with the stick figure - have it animate TYLER in battlegrounds in GFD.' Implemented in REDGARDEN (the upstream arena client GFD's battlegrounds_gui forks from, per founder direction to do the work there first). Vendored GOLDENBAND's C sampler (packages/goldenband, from /home/fatbaby/GOLDENBAND/src), hand-authored idle/walk BVH clips matching a hardcoded 5-joint skeleton (Hips->Spine->{Head,L_Arm,R_Arm}), ran them through the real gbtool import pipeline to produce real .gband files, wrote forward-kinematics + box-per-joint rendering (gband_rig.c) wired into ARENA_HERO_TYLER's draw call, replacing its old single static box. Idle/walk state derived client-side from position deltas. Live-verified under Xvfb: two screenshots a second apart show a real multi-box rig with a visible pose shift, confirming the sample->FK->render chain actually runs. Existing test suite (test_arena.sh) still fully passes. REDGARDEN commits 8dbf1c3/a28a186. Full plan: GoblinFoxDragon/docs2/GOLDENBAND_INTEGRATION_NORTHSTAR.md.
title: S144-06: GOLDENBAND box-rig drives Tyler's animation in Battlegrounds
